verdict.rationale: Auth0 markets giving each agent a unique digital identity (auth0-docs-20) and documents M2M client-credentials identities that authenticate the application rather than a user (auth0-docs-8, auth0-docs-54). It also offers scopes and granular permissions for M2M communications (auth0-docs-81) and delegated agent access that avoids broad, unrestricted access (auth0-docs-16), which together cover the per-agent, least-privilege core of the story. Missing for 10: any evidence of instant revocation of agent credentials or tokens, in-depth docs on per-agent identity beyond a marketing line, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
